releasePlan.notes: Control path (flag off): skips login overlay entirely, shows original GALACTIC DEFENDER title screen immediately after LD init — exact pre-PR behavior. v1 path (flag on): shows callsign entry overlay, captures player name, persists to localStorage, updates HUD PLAYER display, and re-identifies the LD context per callsign. isTypingTarget() keyboard guard and restartGame() loginOverlay safety-close are unconditional (not flag-gated). The LD client is initialized before flag evaluation so variation() is available at the gating point.
